Twin Tails in Kanturu Relics are causing great harm to travelers. Go to Kanturu Relics and hunt down 100 Twin Tails. Come see me when that's done to receive an Invisibility Cloak + 7 as a reward. At your current level, it'll be too dangerous for you to hunt the monsters alone. It'll be better if you hunt in a party.

Unfortunately, Secrarium was betting that darkness in the hearts of the travelers would ultimately lead to hostility and discord among them. Lugard was also aware of the travelers' dark side, but his trust in them didn't waver. Ultimately, the travelers did begin to feud with one another like the dark god had anticipated, and Chaos Castle became ever more... chaotic.
